tagline: Websites & automations for UK small businesses
heroTitle: Websites that win you customers. Automations that save you hours.
heroSubtitle: I hand-code fast, custom websites (no page builders, no bloated templates) and set up simple automations — enquiries straight to your WhatsApp, online bookings, review requests — so your business runs smoother while you get on with the work.
aboutText:
BisoDesign is a one-person web studio. I build websites in pure code — HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Next.js — instead of drag-and-drop builders, which means they load fast, rank better on Google and don't come with a monthly platform fee.

Most of my clients are small UK businesses — trades, recovery and transport companies, salons and local shops — who need a site that brings in calls and enquiries, not just one that looks nice. On top of the website, I set up the automations that save time every day: enquiries sent straight to your phone, online bookings, automatic follow-ups and review requests.

You deal with me directly, from the first call to launch and beyond — no account managers, no outsourcing. You get a fixed price before any work starts, and I stay available for fixes and changes after your site goes live.
whatsappMessage: Hi! I'd like to talk about a website project.

services.title: Custom Websites
services.description: Hand-coded, mobile-first websites designed around your business and your customers — fast to load, easy to find on Google, and built to turn visitors into calls and enquiries.

services.title: Business Automations
services.description: Stop doing the same admin by hand. Contact forms that land on your WhatsApp or in a Google Sheet, online booking, automatic email replies and follow-ups, review requests after every job, simple quote and invoice flows.

services.title: Lead-Generating Features
services.description: Click-to-call and WhatsApp buttons, GPS location sharing for call-outs, quote request forms, customer review systems — the features that actually make your phone ring.

services.title: Redesigns & Refreshes
services.description: Got a site that feels outdated, loads slowly or isn't bringing in work? I'll rebuild it with a modern look, a clearer structure and much better performance.

services.title: Local SEO & Google Presence
services.description: On-page SEO, schema markup, sitemap, Google Business Profile setup and speed optimisation — so local customers searching for what you do can actually find you.

services.title: Maintenance & Bug Fixes
services.description: Broken layouts, forms that stopped working, slow pages, updates and small changes — I find the root cause, fix it properly and keep your site running smoothly after launch.

portfolio.title: Sayah Recovery
portfolio.description: Website for a vehicle & HGV recovery company in North London. Built so stranded drivers can get help in seconds: SOS call buttons, a WhatsApp button that shares the driver's GPS location automatically, a moderated customer review system with its own admin panel, and local SEO (schema.org + sitemap). Hand-coded in HTML, CSS & JavaScript with Firebase.

portfolio.title: Lumi Beauty Studio
portfolio.description: Concept website for a beauty salon: services and pricing, photo gallery, client testimonials and an online booking section. Warm, elegant design built to convey trust and make booking effortless.

portfolio.title: Green Corner Market
portfolio.description: Concept website for a local neighbourhood shop: product categories, opening hours, location and customer reviews, with scroll animations, hover effects and an animated stats counter.

faq.question: How long does a typical project take?
faq.answer: Anywhere from 2 to 8 weeks depending on the package and scope — Spark projects are usually fastest, Nova projects take longer given the custom work involved.

faq.question: What kind of automations can you set up?
faq.answer: Anything that saves you repetitive admin: enquiries sent straight to your WhatsApp, email or a Google Sheet, online bookings with confirmations, automatic replies and follow-ups, review requests after a job, and simple quote or invoice flows. Tell me what you do by hand every week and I'll tell you what can be automated.

faq.question: Why hand-coded instead of Wix, Squarespace or WordPress?
faq.answer: Hand-coded sites load faster, rank better on Google, have no plugins to break or get hacked, and don't lock you into a monthly platform subscription. You own the code.

faq.question: What happens if I need changes after launch?
faq.answer: Small fixes and tweaks are covered for a short period after launch. For ongoing changes, updates and hosting help, I offer a simple monthly maintenance plan — ask when we talk.

faq.question: Do you work with clients outside the UK?
faq.answer: Yes — most of the process happens over calls and messages, so location isn't a barrier.

faq.question: Do I need to have my content and images ready?
faq.answer: It helps, but it's not required — I can help you write the text, find suitable images, and swap in your own photos later.

faq.question: What if I'm not sure which package fits my project?
faq.answer: That's completely normal — get in touch and we'll figure out the right scope together before any commitment.
